text_block_list.text: …I stop once in front of the school gate and gently touch the brand new collar badge.
My chest trembles. …Starting today, my days here at Tracen Academy as an Umamusume trainer will begin.
The destination is already set. …It has been set, long ago.
I run with everything I have. …Toward the promised place. Toward her.
And then…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ……Hehe... Are you okay? Your face is completely red.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But… you rushed here… all the way, with everything you had, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I’ve been waiting the whole time. …“Trainer!”
Her expression is far more grown-up than back then. Yet the pure, piercing brightness that strikes my chest has never changed.
It was such a girl—Buena Vista—that I met. Both of us were still very young.

text_block_list.name: Buena’s Mother
text_block_list.text: …Come now, say hello. This is <username>-kun, who moved in next door. Please get along well, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: …Big brother…? Um… you know, I’m Buu-chan. Nice… to meet you?

text_block_list.text: …Big sister…? Um… you know, I’m Buu-chan. Nice… to meet you?
I remember. When I nervously grasped the small hand she timidly held out, her fluffy tail gently swayed behind her.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Sniff, uuuh…! It hurts, right? It’s painful, right…? You keep coughing… and your fever… uuuh…!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: But, but…! You know, I’ve grown bigger. I can carry you now, big brother! See…!?

text_block_list.text: I remember. Seeing her so persistent, her overflowing— far too overflowing sensitivity and kindness felt endearing.
…I remember. It was a day after Buena Vista had been attending the club where young Umamusume learn to run.

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone! Time for a mock race~. Is everyone ready? Then… on your marks… go!!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Go! …Taaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hehe… yeah, not yet!! Yaaaaaaahhhh!!
Seeing her serious run for the first time… it was far, far too powerful, striking my heart.
…And that night, I was so excited I couldn’t sleep at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …What, you’re choosing to go to a trainer academy!? And the central one…!?
choice_data_list: <size=32>Yeah. …I’ve actually been thinking about it for a long time...</size>

text_block_list.text: “Ever since I first saw you run, I’ve truly always…” Continuing so, I brace myself and strike my chest before her. “I…”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …!! That… means—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Ahh… geez. You know I’m a crybaby. Saying it suddenly… it’s a little unfair.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But… thank you. I’ll work hard too. I’ll definitely pass Tracen Academy!
It was a childish promise, almost reckless. Yet it began to shine brightly… on that day.
Buena Vista successfully became a Tracen Academy student… and as for me, I was studying hard to pass the trainer qualification exam that autumn.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um… how is it? The charm.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I think I made it a bit better than the one I gave you for your entrance exam support… or at least, that’s what I tell myself. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No no. …Ah, I have to get to the stands soon! I want to secure a spot where I can see well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Both you and I are studying together today! For the “Japan Cup,” did you choose the Umamusume to watch? I did—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I think… Special Week-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: TAAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: It’s Special Week, Special Week!! Special Week takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: The other Umamusume are chasing desperately, but Special Week!! Number 13, Special Week, crosses the finish line first!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Japan’s pride, Special Week!! Defeating even the Arc-winning Umamusume, with dignity— with dignity, wins the “Japan Cup”!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Amazing… amazing, amazing!! What a run, what an impact, what cheers… what a—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! Yeah. Yeah, yeah…!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: What a breathtaking view…!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey. Someday, absolutely, we too—!
“Someday, we’ll definitely reach such a breathtaking view.”
The childhood promise thus became the irreplaceable dream of the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Then… once again. …Can I hear it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Okay.
